title: DRV Argument-in-One-Page  -  REWRITE v2

canonical_node.axiom: The Master Equation is the integrated product of ten typed factors, each with a fixed mathematical domain, and the distinction between the factor C and the output chi is structural.
definitions: G: external negentropy influx rate, domain 0
M: alignment cosine between system state and reference vector, domain [1,1]
E: signal propagation fidelity (channel capacity), domain 0
S_prod: entropy production rate, enters as S_eff = e^( S_prod), domain 0
chi: integrated output, not a factor
derivation: The original variable labels were type-incompatible with the canonical Definition 10.
The dV element is corrected from dx dy dt to dx dt per the canon.
The entropy sign repair S_eff = e^( S_prod) is added explicitly, verified antitone by the Lean kernel.
The C vs chi distinction is enforced: C is a factor, chi is the output, never confused.
The Ten Laws table is replaced by the canonical Layer 2 ten-factor bridge.
The asymmetry structure is reduced to two canonical asymmetries: F directional, C sovereign.
Free will is anchored to Factor M (alignment cosine) per Axiom 3.
The Unified Field Equation is reframed as a reduced-form coherence equation.
The Lowe Coherence Lagrangian is marked provisional, not Lean-verified.
The K-Drop argument is anchored to Factors G and K, with the intelligence inference marked named-contestable.
canonical_node.action: The system must use the canonical typed factors and the C vs chi distinction in all formal statements, and must mark provisional or contestable claims explicitly.
boundary: Does not assert the Lowe Coherence Lagrangian as Lean-verified.
Does not assert the five-pair fractal symmetry structure.
Does not assert 'Christ is coherence' as a formal identity; only as Asymmetry 2 reframing.
Does not claim the K-Drop intelligence inference as proven; it is named-contestable.
test: Check that every variable in the Master Equation uses the canonical domain.
Check that C is never used as the output chi.
Check that the dV element is dx dt.
Check that the entropy term is S_eff = e^( S_prod).
Check that the Ten Laws table is replaced by the Layer 2 bridge.
Check that the Lagrangian is labeled provisional.
Check that the K-Drop intelligence inference is marked named-contestable.

dg1_dependencies: FORMAL_VERIFICATION_PACKET_2026-05-10/ (Layer 1, Layer 2, Definition 10, Axiom 3, Formal Theory v1.0)
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a corrected, canon-aligned Master Equation with typed domains and explicit C vs chi distinction, and reframes several claims to avoid overreach.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: The core argument that coherence is an integrated product of ten factors and that energy is not grace is preserved.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the typed domains or C vs chi distinction are removed, the Master Equation becomes ambiguous and the no-drift fix is lost.
dg5_translation_registers: Physical: open-system thermodynamics, Shannon channel capacity, Kolmogorov compression, phase transitions, quantum superposition, entanglement, integrated information
Spiritual: Grace, Logos, Christ, moral alignment, sin, faith, conversion

overstatement_risks: The Master Equation itself is not proven; it is a definitional framework.
The Lean kernel verifies only structural properties, not the full equation.
The Lowe Coherence Lagrangian is explicitly provisional.
The K-Drop intelligence inference is named-contestable.
kill_conditions: If the canonical Definition 10 is superseded, the typed domains change.
If the Lean kernel rejects the entropy sign repair, the Master Equation fails.
If the C vs chi distinction is violated in any formal statement.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the Master Equation with typed factors and verify the antitone property of S_eff.

plain_summary: This document is a revision of the DRV argument-in-one-page, correcting the Master Equation to use canonical typed factors, fixing the entropy sign, distinguishing C from chi, and reframing several claims to avoid overreach. It marks the Lowe Coherence Lagrangian as provisional and the K-Drop intelligence inference as contestable. The document is coherent and admissible, but it does not establish new proofs; it aligns with the existing canon.
